The original R13 plan both authorized that versioned default switch and declared any R12 verifier failure a falsifier, making closure impossible despite preserved historical bytes. For every frozen absolute repository path, compare current bytes when unchanged and otherwise compare `git show 1b6ffed6:<relative-path>` to the frozen hash. Independently recheck R12 closure evidence hashes, R13 attempt-005 freeze hashes and semantic fields, current default v2 import, the captured expected old-verifier mismatch, zero external participation, and preserved user work. Record a compact R1 recheck and source-grounded closure; change no runtime/source/evidence bytes.

Git object reads establish historical byte identity; the current R13 verifier establishes the promoted v2 runtime result. No Miter cognitive consumer, PeTTa process, Prolog effect membrane, model, credential, service, or external effect is invoked.
falsifiers: Any R12 frozen path is absent or differs from its historical commit; any current R12 evidence/closure hash changes; R13 attempt-005 freeze or evidence changes; the current R13 verifier fails; current default does not import v2 exactly once; the old mismatch is absent or misclassified as a semantic R12 failure; any runtime/model/service/effect occurs; any user path changes; or the fidelity closer finds an unclassified path.

rollback: Remove only the R1 documentation and verifier if the version-aware package fails. Retain R13 implementation/evidence, captured historical mismatch, R12 history, and all user-owned work unchanged. No external state exists to undo.

cases.positive: Every R12 frozen path matches either unchanged current bytes or exact Git bytes at 1b6ffed6; all R12 closure evidence matches; current R13 verifier and v2 default identity pass.
cases.severed: A changed historical object, current R12 evidence byte, R13 frozen byte, v2 default import, or zero-effect field makes R1 fail.

cases.restored: Selecting each claim's exact historical/current version restores verification without editing evidence or source.
cases.held_out: No runtime held-out case; R1 is a version-boundary and package correction only.
cases.unknown_malformed: Missing Git object/path, absolute path outside the repository, malformed freeze/closure, or unclassified worktree path fails explicitly.
